# AAP Insurance Program

> > Comprehensive insurance solutions for AAP members including medical malpractice, business, personal, and specialty coverage tailored for pediatric professionals.

The AAP Insurance Program, administered by USI Affinity, offers a full suite of insurance products designed specifically for American Academy of Pediatrics members. Coverage spans professional liability, practice operations, and personal financial protection with member-exclusive rates and benefits.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice Insurance
- Business Owner's Policy
- Personal Insurance
- Cyber Liability Insurance
- Long-Term Disability
- Life Insurance (Term & Level)
- Long-Term Care Insurance
- Dental & Vision Insurance
- Medicare Supplement
- Employment Practices Liability (EPLI)
- Office Overhead Expense Insurance
- Travel Insurance
- QuickDecision Approval
- Portable Coverage
- AAP Member Benefits

## Professional Liability Coverage

- [AAP - Medical Malpractice](https://www.aapinsurance.com/medical-malpractice): Medical malpractice insurance for AAP members with claims-made and occurrence options.

## Business Insurance for Pediatric Practices

- [AAP - Business Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/practice-insurance): Business insurance for pediatric practices including BOP, cyber liability, and EPLI.
- [AAP - Business Owner's Policy](https://www.aapinsurance.com/practice-insurance/business-owners-policy): Business owner's policy with property, liability, and practice income protection.
- [AAP - Cyber Liability Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/practice-insurance/cyber-liability-insurance): Cyber liability insurance covering ransomware, data breach, and business interruption.
- [AAP - Employment Practices Liability Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/practice-insurance/epli): Employment practices liability insurance for pediatric practice risk management.
- [AAP - Office Overhead Expense Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/office-overhead-expense-insurance): Office overhead disability insurance for pediatric practice owners and business expenses.

## Life & Disability Insurance

- [AAP - Level Term Life Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/level-term-life-insurance): Fixed-rate level term life insurance with QuickDecision approval and portable coverage.
- [AAP - Renewable Term LIfe Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/renewable-term-life-insurance): Renewable term life insurance with disability protection and accelerated death benefits.
- [AAP - Long-Term Disability Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/long-term-disability-insurance): Long-term disability insurance providing income protection for AAP members.
- [AAP - Accidental Death & Dismemberment Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/add-insurance): Accidental death and dismemberment coverage with portable benefits for AAP members.

## Health & Wellness Coverage

- [AAP - Personal Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance): Personal insurance plans including life, disability, dental, vision, and long-term care.
- [AAP - Dental & Vision Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/dental-vision-insurance): MetLife dental and vision insurance plans with network providers and claim processing.
- [AAP - Long-Term Care Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/long-term-care-insurance): Long-term care insurance (LTCR*plus*) with group discounts and Medicare/Medicaid guidance.
- [AAP - Medicare Solutions](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/medicare-supplement): Medicare supplement solutions with licensed agents and enrollment assistance.

## Additional Member Benefits

- [AAP - Travel Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/travel-insurance): Travel insurance with trip cancellation, medical coverage, and annual plan options.
- [AAP - Pet Insurance](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/pet-insurance): Hartville pet insurance with accident and illness coverage for AAP members.
- [AAP - Student Loan Refinancing](https://www.aapinsurance.com/personal-insurance/student-loan-refinancing): SoFi student loan refinancing with member discounts and rate benefits.

## Resources & Education

- [The AAP Insurance Program](https://www.aapinsurance.com): AAP Insurance Program homepage offering medical malpractice, business, and personal insurance for members.
- [AAP - Resource Center](https://www.aapinsurance.com/resource-center): Resource center with webinars, risk management guides, and insurance education.
- [Financial Wellness](https://www.aapinsurance.com/resource-center/financial-wellness): Financial wellness video series covering budgeting, credit, and insurance topics.
